definitions.explanation: A negative evaluation or unfavorable public opinion about a person, product, or policy. Can refer to specific critical reviews or a general reputation for being poor.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{悪評|あくひょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: That movie has many bad reviews.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{政策|せいさく}は{市民|しみん}から{悪評|あくひょう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: The new policy earned a bad reputation among citizens.

examples.japanese: {悪評|あくひょう}にもかかわらず、その{店|みせ}はいつも{混|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: Despite the bad reviews, that shop is always crowded.

notes:
A negative evaluation or unfavorable reputation. Composed of {悪|あく} (bad) + {評|ひょう} (review/reputation). Can refer to both a bad review of a specific thing (film, product) and a general bad reputation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪評|あくひょう}を{買|か}う: to earn a bad reputation
- {悪評|あくひょう}が{立|た}つ: to get a bad name
- {悪評|あくひょう}が{広|ひろ}まる: for a bad reputation to spread
- {悪評|あくひょう}{高|たか}い: notorious, infamous

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好評|こうひょう}: good reputation/favorable review — the direct opposite
- {評判|ひょうばん}: reputation/reviews — neutral term that can be good or bad
- {不評|ふひょう}: unpopularity/poor reception — similar but emphasizes lack of popularity rather than active negative criticism
